reason: They don't name the payment partner, the fee per transaction or when the money lands in my account, so I can't sign up yet. My regulars already book and hear about events through Instagram and WhatsApp for free, so I'm not chasing a loyalty tool.
objection: A fee "charged on top" with no number, from a payment company I don't know. If it's more than my bank terminal charges, or the money sits there for days, every table that pays by QR costs me money.
would_change_my_mind: Tell me the payment partner by name, a fee at or under what my terminal costs, and payout the next day. Then I'd try the free 3 months.
